headline: New Flare At Godcrofts As Stonecradle Wakes
war_summary: Three hours past the last edition the wires report fresh movement after the lull, led by Godcrofts, now six Warden to three Colonial after forty-two changes in the day, twelve in the last two hours about The Axehead, Fleecewatch and Isawa. Fisherman's Row remains active to the hour with twenty-nine changes in the day, two in the last two hours about Arcadia and Eidolo, standing eight Colonial with one base neutral. Stonecradle has stirred anew with four changes in two hours to 07:56 about The Heir's Knife and Trammel Pool, standing five Warden to four Colonial amid 5,204 Colonial and 6,339 Warden losses in the day. Mooring County adds three changes in two hours at The Wind Hills and holds twelve Warden to none. Callahan's Passage, Linn Mercy, Stlican Shelf, Farranac Coast, Viper Pit and Weathered Expanse show no change in two hours, though Weathered Expanse still counts thirty-six changes in the day about Frostmarch and Wightwalk with the heaviest day's toll at 10,385 Colonial to 12,131 Warden.
